description: Source code implementing SSL/TLS socket handling, certificate management, and OpenSSL initialization for secure communication in the Thunder Crypto namespace.

classes.name: OpenSSL
classes.description: Helper class for initializing OpenSSL library functions, ensuring one-time setup.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X509 certificate, providing methods to access issuer, subject, validity period, and hostname validation.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic key, supporting loading from files and reference management.

classes.name: CertificateStore
classes.description: Manages a collection of trusted X509 certificates, supporting addition and reference management.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler
classes.description: Handles SSL/TLS socket operations, including handshake, certificate validation, read/write, and context management.

methods.name: Certificate::Certificate
methods.description: Constructs a Certificate object from an existing x509_st pointer or from a file.

methods.name: Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer name of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject name of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate is valid for a given hostname.

methods.name: Key::Key
methods.description: Constructs a Key object from a key pointer or from a file, with optional password.

methods.name: Key::~Key
methods.description: Destructor that frees the key resource.

methods.name: CertificateStore::Add
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the store.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::CreateContext
methods.description: Creates SSL context with specified method.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes SSL connection, setting hostname and handshake state.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Certificate
methods.description: Loads server certificate and private key into SSL context.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Root
methods.description: Sets trusted certificate store for SSL context.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Handler::Update
methods.description: Performs SSL handshake steps and updates handshake state.
